title: Cultural Tourism
duration: 45 hours (30 hours of lectures and 15 hours of seminars/practicals)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the relationship between culture and tourism, and the conditions for developing cultural tourism.
Analyze the cultural tourism market and its products.
Manage and utilize cultural tourism resources sustainably.
Develop and market cultural tourism products suitable for the Vietnamese market.
Manage and develop sustainable cultural tourism.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Deliver effective presentations on cultural tourism topics.
Analyze and critique cultural tourism issues and solutions.
Demonstrate responsibility towards the environment and society in cultural tourism.
Respect cultural diversity and preserve traditional Vietnamese cultural values.
